name: Glide through water for five metres
short_description: Glide through water for five metres once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can glide through water for five metres in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Glide through water for five metres means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Glide through water for five metres in a fresh real-life scenario.
